9774.text: A 4.5 km walk with 666 m of climbing, about 3 h 11 min of walking. It tops out at 2,181 m, mostly on footpaths, with steep mountain paths in places. On the way: the hut Alte Traunsteiner Hütte and the cave Zeller Eishöhle. It passes below the peak Wagendrischelhorn (2,251 m).

98006.text: A 13.8 km loop with 341 m of climbing, about 4 h 22 min of walking. It tops out at 354 m. On the way: the viewpoint König Baudoin Turm, the peak Vaalserberg (323 m) and the lake Casinoweiher. It goes close to drielandenpunt. Usually walkable all year.

9805.text: An 18.7 km loop with 558 m of climbing, about 6 h 09 min of walking. It tops out at 413 m, mostly on paved roads. On the way: the lake Seebad Riegersburg, the peak Buchberg (397 m) and the castle Äußeres Burggebäude. Usually walkable all year.

9808.text: A 16.6 km loop with 519 m of climbing, about 5 h 29 min of walking. It tops out at 414 m, mostly on paved roads. On the way: the castles Schloss Kornberg and Meierhof zu Schloss Kornberg, and the lake Meissl-Teiche. Usually walkable all year.

98107.text: An 8 km loop with 240 m of climbing, about 2 h 37 min of walking. It tops out at 549 m. On the way: the ruin Dreistegen, the monastery Kloster Reichenstein and the peak Ehrensteinsley (507 m). Usually walkable all year.

9824.text: A 16.5 km walk with 1,919 m of climbing, about 10 h 15 min of walking over 2 days. It tops out at 2,369 m, mostly on footpaths. On the way: the waterfalls Landtalbach Wasserfall and Röthbachfall. It passes below the peak Wildalmrotkopf (2,517 m). Usually clear of snow from July to September.

9842.text: A 65.5 km walk with 3,507 m of climbing, about 26 h 30 min of walking over 5 days. It tops out at 1,986 m. On the way: the peaks Lärchkogel (1,894 m), Speikkogel (1,988 m) and Roßbachkogel (1,848 m). Usually clear of snow from June to October.

98568.text: Stage 1 of the GR 56 Variantes et Liasons. A 7.8 km walk with 300 m of climbing, about 2 h 37 min of walking. It tops out at 337 m, mostly on paved roads. On the way: the lake Tritonenbrunnen, and the peaks Scherpenberg (269 m) and Vaalserberg (323 m). Usually walkable all year.

9861.text: A 4.4 km walk with 988 m of climbing, about 4 h 01 min of walking. It tops out at 2,558 m, mostly on footpaths, with steep mountain paths in places. On the way: the peaks Stuhlgrabenkogel (1,881 m), Stuhljoch (2,446 m) and Funtenseetauern (2,578 m). Usually clear of snow from July to September.

9894.text: Stage 22 of the Via Alpina Purple. A 17.6 km walk from Knittelfeld to Ingering II with 825 m of climbing, about 6 h 23 min of walking. It tops out at 1,203 m. On the way: the lake Ziegelteich, the peak Tremmelberg (1,194 m) and the viewpoint Turm im Gebirge. Usually clear of snow from April to November.

9897.text: A 5.4 km walk with 1,034 m of climbing, about 3 h 06 min of walking. It tops out at 2,001 m, with steep mountain paths in places. On the way: the lake Drachensee and the hut Coburger Hütte. Usually clear of snow from June to October.

99004.text: A 70.5 km walk with 1,598 m of climbing, about 21 h 59 min of walking over 4 days. It tops out at 296 m. On the way: the castles Château Amand, Château-ferme de Maredsous and Château Boël. It goes close to Dinant. Usually walkable all year.

99006.text: A 38.7 km walk with 705 m of climbing, about 11 h 32 min of walking over 2 days. It tops out at 146 m, mostly on paved roads. On the way: the peak Flotsenberg (102 m), and the castles Kasteel Calmeyn and Kasteel van Beersel. It goes close to Manneken Peace and Brussels. Usually walkable all year.

9920.text: A 7.6 km walk with 1,031 m of climbing, about 5 h 33 min of walking. It tops out at 2,391 m, with steep mountain paths in places. On the way: the peaks Muttekopf (2,046 m) and Kuhköpfe (2,064 m). It passes below the peak Rotschrofenkopf (2,436 m). Usually clear of snow from July to September.

9929.text: A 6.5 km walk with 576 m of climbing, about 4 h 54 min of walking. It tops out at 2,489 m, mostly on footpaths, with steep mountain paths in places. On the way: the lakes Unterer Parzinnsee, Oberer Parzinnsee and Kogelsee. Usually clear of snow from July to September.

9936.text: A 5.5 km walk with 489 m of climbing, about 2 h 08 min of walking. It tops out at 2,272 m, mostly on footpaths. It passes below the peaks Hafelekarspitze (2,334 m), Mandlspitze (2,366 m) and Südliches Gleierschtaler Brandjoch (2,374 m). Usually clear of snow from July to September.

9959.text: A 16.5 km walk with 1,268 m of climbing, about 8 h 47 min of walking. It tops out at 2,184 m. On the way: the peaks Gschöllkopf (2,039 m) and Rofanturm (2,150 m). It passes below the peak Rofanspitze (2,259 m). Usually clear of snow from July to September.

99878.text: Stage 3 of the Via Arduinna. A 23.3 km walk with 478 m of climbing, about 7 h 18 min of walking. It tops out at 631 m. On the way: the viewpoint Belvédère de La Roche, the castle Le Château Féodal and the ruin Tour de Chamont. It goes close to La Roche-en-Ardenne. Usually clear of snow from April to November.
